title: Direct image, presheaf inverse image and inverse image along a continuous map, with units
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a continuous map of topological spaces and let $\mathcal C$ be the category of sets, the category of abelian groups or the category of commutative rings. (1) For a presheaf $\mathcal F$ on $X$ with values in $\mathcal C$, the *direct image* $f_*\mathcal F$ is the presheaf $V\mapsto\mathcal F(f^{-1}V)$ on $Y$, with the restriction maps of $\mathcal F$; a morphism $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F'$ gives $f_*\varphi$ with $(f_*\varphi)_V=\varphi_{f^{-1}V}$; if $\mathcal F$ is a sheaf, so is $f_*\mathcal F$. (2) For a presheaf $\mathcal G$ on $Y$ with values in $\mathcal C$, the *presheaf inverse image* $f_p\mathcal G$ is the presheaf on $X$ with $f_p\mathcal G(U)=\varinjlim_{V\supseteq f(U)}\mathcal G(V)$, the colimit in $\mathcal C$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] over the open subsets $V\subseteq Y$ containing $f(U)$ ordered by reverse inclusion (a directed set, closed under finite intersections), with coprojections $\iota^U_V:\mathcal G(V)\to f_p\mathcal G(U)$; for opens $U'\subseteq U$ of $X$ the restriction map $f_p\mathcal G(U)\to f_p\mathcal G(U')$ is the unique morphism sending $\iota^U_V$ to $\iota^{U'}_V$ (every $V\supseteq f(U)$ contains $f(U')$); a morphism $u:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G'$ gives $f_pu$ with $(f_pu)_U\circ\iota^U_V=\iota'^U_V\circ u_V$. Since $f(f^{-1}V)\subseteq V$, the maps $i_{\mathcal G,V}=\iota^{f^{-1}V}_V:\mathcal G(V)\to f_p\mathcal G(f^{-1}V)$ form a morphism of presheaves $i_{\mathcal G}:\mathcal G\to f_*f_p\mathcal G$, natural in $\mathcal G$; it is the unit of an adjunction $f_p\dashv f_*$ on presheaves with values in $\mathcal C$. (3) For a sheaf $\mathcal G$ on $Y$ with values in $\mathcal C$, the *inverse image* is the sheafification $\theta_{\mathcal G}:f_p\mathcal G\to f^{-1}\mathcal G:=(f_p\mathcal G)^\#$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], and for a morphism of sheaves $u:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G'$, $f^{-1}u$ is the unique morphism of sheaves with $f^{-1}u\circ\theta_{\mathcal G}=\theta_{\mathcal G'}\circ f_pu$. The functor $f^{-1}$ is left adjoint to $f_*$ on sheaves with values in $\mathcal C$, by the composite bijection $\mathrm{Hom}(f^{-1}\mathcal G,\mathcal F)=\mathrm{Hom}(f_p\mathcal G,\mathcal F)=\mathrm{Hom}(\mathcal G,f_*\mathcal F)$, and the unit of this adjunction is $\eta_{\mathcal G}=f_*(\theta_{\mathcal G})\circ i_{\mathcal G}:\mathcal G\to f_*f^{-1}\mathcal G$, that is, $\eta_{\mathcal G,V}=\theta_{\mathcal G,f^{-1}V}\circ\iota^{f^{-1}V}_V:\mathcal G(V)\to(f^{-1}\mathcal G)(f^{-1}V)$ for $V\subseteq Y$ open.
